title: Redesigning Tourism: A Youth Perspective
summary: A free three-hour UWI discussion and workshop on AI, innovation and the future of Caribbean tourism, with invited speakers and an open forum.
description: The UWI Tourism Society and The Academic Lounge are hosting Redesigning Tourism: A Youth Perspective at the FSS Lounge, UWI St. Augustine on Thursday 1 October 2026 from 1:00 PM to 4:00 PM. The free programme includes invited speakers, interactive group discussions and an open forum focused on technology, innovation and the future of tourism in Trinidad and Tobago and the wider Caribbean. Places are limited and registration is subject to confirmation.
